decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the accessories like wall shelves, travel cases, and replacement batteries to focus on the speakers themselves. My consideration set includes a range of options from premium (JBL Charge 5) to budget-portable (JBL Go 3) and high-power value brands (BOGASING M4). I chose the JBL Charge 5 as my final purchase because it has the highest rating (4.8) and offers the best combination of sound quality, ruggedness (IP67), and battery life (20 hours), which justifies its higher price point for a long-term investment.
